exposure: Antidepressant exposure during early-mid pregnancy (overall, and categorized by affinity to histamine-1 receptor)
cohort: The study included 6647 pregnancies of women with depressive/anxiety disorders during and/or 6 months prior to pregnancy, participating in the Norwegian Mother, Father and Child Cohort Study.
finding: Gestational use of antidepressants with low H1 receptor affinity (mainly SSRIs and SNRIs) during early-mid pregnancy was not associated with a substantial risk of gestational diabetes mellitus.
